message.content:
# NVIDIA Meeting Briefing
**Date of Meeting:** November 20, 2026  

## Recent developments
* **CEO Transition & Leadership Changes:** On November 12, 2026, NVIDIA announced that founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned [1]. Colette Kress, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, was appointed as Interim CEO, and Harvey C. Jones was appointed as the company's first-ever Chair of the Board [1].
* **Board Investigation and Personal Conduct Reports:** The leadership transition followed an independent board investigation initiated in November 2026 after reports regarding personal conduct and foreign intelligence scrutiny involving associates [2, 3]. Jensen Huang issued a public message to employees addressing the matter [1, 4].
* **Partnership Announcements:** Prior to the leadership changes, NVIDIA announced a collaboration with Rebellions and SK Telecom on November 8, 2026, to advance sovereign AI infrastructure utilizing NVIDIA NVLink Fusion [1].
* **Financial Reporting:** NVIDIA scheduled its third-quarter financial results conference call for late October/November 2026 [1].

## Talking points
* **Leadership and Continuity:** Discuss how the interim leadership team under Colette Kress plans to maintain operational stability and execute NVIDIA's strategic roadmap following Jensen Huang's departure.
* **Sovereign AI Strategy:** Review the progress and timelines for the recently announced collaboration with SK Telecom and Rebellions regarding sovereign AI infrastructure using NVLink Fusion [1].
* **Upcoming Financial Outlook:** Address expectations for the third-quarter financial results and ongoing demand dynamics for NVIDIA's accelerated computing and AI platforms.

## Open questions
* What is the anticipated timeline and process for the permanent CEO selection?
* How will the interim leadership team address ongoing regulatory and geopolitical considerations concerning key international markets?
* Are there any anticipated adjustments to enterprise strategy, R&D timelines, or partner commitments following the board's structural updates and executive changes?

## Sources
* [1] NVIDIA Newsroom - CEO Transition & Announcements: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition
* [2] NVIDIA Newsroom - Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors
* [3] CBS News - Timeline of Jensen Huang's Resignation: https://www.cbsnews.com/news/jensen-huang-nvidia-resignation-scandal-timeline
* [4] NVIDIA Newsroom - A Message to Our Company: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/a-message-to-our-company
* [5] Fortune - Context on NVIDIA, China, and Recent Reports: https://fortune.com/2026/11/09/jensen-huang-nvidia-china-affair-alice-huang-suspected-chinese-spy
